name: @lightsoft-dev/feedback-pal-mcp
stderr:
[feedback-pal-mcp] FEEDBACK_PAL_URL(또는 --url)이 필요합니다.

feedback-pal-mcp — Feedback Pal MCP 서버 (stdio)

사용법:
  FEEDBACK_PAL_URL=https://feedback.example.com FEEDBACK_PAL_TOKEN=<ADMIN_API_TOKEN> npx -y @lightsoft-dev/feedback-pal-mcp
  npx -y @lightsoft-dev/feedback-pal-mcp --url https://feedback.example.com --token <ADMIN_API_TOKEN>

Claude Code 등록:
  claude mcp add feedback-pal -e FEEDBACK_PAL_URL=https://feedback.example.com -e FEEDBACK_PAL_TOKEN=<token> -- npx -y @lightsoft-dev/feedback-pal-mcp
